gloss: reporting to the emperor or a deity; respectful address

definitions.gloss: reporting to the emperor or a deity; humbly stating to a superior
definitions.explanation: Stating something formally to the highest-ranking listener imaginable — the emperor, or a kami at a shrine. Survives today almost only in Shinto ritual language and in historical writing.

examples.japanese: {神前|しんぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奏上|そうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To offer the ritual prayer before the deity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奏上|そうじょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He reported the results of the investigation to the emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵巻|えまき}→絵巻：14098_emaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現状|げんじょう}→現状：02721_genjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奏上|そうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This picture scroll depicts a scene in which a minister reports the state of the country to the emperor.

notes:
An extremely formal word with no everyday use; a learner will meet it at shrines, in historical drama, and in writing about the imperial court.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{奏上|そうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to offer a Shinto prayer to the deity
- ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{奏上|そうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to report to the emperor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上奏|じょうそう}→上奏：30675_jousou⟧: memorial to the throne — near-synonym, more common in political and legal history
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report — the neutral everyday word for telling a superior something
